title: foldsite: structure-first active-site mapping across protein folds
description: A tool that reads the catalytic state of a protein fold from predicted structures. It superposes a candidate on a reference with TM-align and reports, for each chemistry-defining position, whether the catalytic residue is retained, lost, or unresolved, using an order-aware residue correspondence. Version 0.1.0 implements the active-site-mapping stage with a worked TIR (SARM1 NADase) demo.
